name: uttori-asm-vscode
description: Assembly language support powered by uttori-asm, with bundled SNES support.
author: Matthew Callis <matthew.callis@gmail.com>

scripts.fmt: oxfmt --config ../../.oxfmtrc.json src esbuild.mjs package.json tsconfig.json language-configuration.json syntaxes/uttori-asm.tmLanguage.json
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --config ../../.oxfmtrc.json --check src esbuild.mjs package.json tsconfig.json language-configuration.json syntaxes/uttori-asm.tmLanguage.json

asm.configFile.description: Path to asm.config.json relative to the workspace root. When empty, asm.config.json is discovered automatically.

asm.plugins.description: Plugin module specifiers appended to plugins from asm.config.json. Workspace Trust is required.

asm.target.description: Target contribution ID or alias. The language server validates it against active plugin metadata.

asm.entryPoints.description: Project entry-point files (relative to the workspace root) analysed as include roots. When empty, each open file is treated as its own root.

asm.includePaths.description: Additional include search paths handed to the assembler. When empty, project configuration or target defaults apply.

asm.architecture.description: Architecture contribution ID or alias. The language server validates it against the selected target.

asm.buildOutput.description: Output path for the assembled binary. When empty, the selected target's default extension is used.

asm.baseImage.description: Optional base image file to patch when building.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Built-in assembly support remains available, but workspace plugin modules and asm.config.json are disabled until the workspace is trusted.
